card.name: Geriatric and comparison phrases in labels
card.fires_on: Small linking words in label sentences that compare groups, such as 'more' after 'elderly patients are' and 'were' after 'No overall differences in safety or effectiveness'. Also 'of' in 'number of cases' and 'frequently' after 'more' or 'most'.

modes.description: The verb 'were' right after 'No overall differences in safety or effectiveness' in the geriatric use section.

modes.label: Frequency adverbs
modes.description: The adverb 'frequently' after 'more' or 'most' when describing how often reactions were reported.
modes.example: injection reactions were more<< frequently>> reported with the first injection; 4
